name: Pocket Drives
tagline: Search luxury, exotic, and EV rentals from independent hosts
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP for Pocket Drives, a peer-to-peer luxury, exotic, and EV rental marketplace. Search inventory, autocomplete locations, check availability, and get quotes. Independent hosts; PocketList Inc builds the platform. Booking finishes in the iOS app. No auth required.

install.notes: Booking finishes in the Pocket Drives iOS app. This server searches, quotes, and browses; it does not book.
